snippet.title: Pokémon Extreme Yellow: Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Kanto at its max (and beyond!)

Pokémon Extreme Yellow is a difficulty romhack of Pokémon Yellow featuring much tougher battles, complex dungeons, restored content, darker story, completely new areas and story arcs, virtually infinite post-game content, and a plethora of customization and randomization options.

Get ready to live again the original adventure like you have never experienced it before!

Out now!
Get your patch from GitHub: https://github.com/RainbowMetalPigeon/ExtremeYellow/releases
Join the Pokémon Extreme Yellow Discord server: https://discord.gg/QAX4c4xMJY
Further discussions on the Reddit post: https://www.reddit.com/r/PokemonROMhacks/comments/1g0oqli/pok%C3%A9mon_extreme_yellow_kanto_at_its_max_and_beyond/

Songs credits:
Pokémon I Choose You!: Pokémon Anime OST
Pokémon Red and Blue - Opening // Metal Cover : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ur2QLxezSa8&ab_channel=SimonLoveridge
Champion Battle Theme Pokemon Red/Blue/Yellow Metal Cover : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mvk_NLPdfgU&ab_channel=SupremeCannon
